title: Forrest Frank Sets Release Date for New Album ‘The Jesus Generation’
summary: Frank also shared social media clips of new music featuring Lecrae, KB, Elevation Rhythm and more.
contentText:
CCM artist Forrest Frank is set to release his new album, The Jesus Generation , on Dec. 4 via River House Records.

Frank announced the new album on social media , along with new music preview clips that include collaborations with Lecrae & KB (“Go Go Go”), JVKE (“Let The Light In”), Michael W. Smith (“Glory Hallelujah”), ZVC *(“My Little Miracle”) and Elevation Rhythm (“Revival’s in the Air”). New music from the album is set to release on Friday (Oct. 30).

The new album follows Frank’s May 2026 single “The Jesus Generation” and his recent sold-out stadium and arena-headlining The Jesus Generation Tour, which sold more than 470,000 tickets within 10 days of its announcement.

Fans will get a deep look at the recent tour via The Jesus Generation Tour Movie , which will hit theaters next year via Lionsgate and Kingdom Story Company.

To date, Frank has earned five GMA Dove Awards and three Grammy nominations. In May, he earned his second chart-topper on Billboard ‘s Hot Christian Songs tally with “Jesus Is Alive!” Since 2023, Frank has logged several hits on the chart, including “No Longer Bound” (featuring Hulvey), “Up!” “Good Day” and “Your Way’s Better,” which became his first song to break through on Billboard ‘s all-genre Hot 100 chart. His song “Lemonade” with The Figs also landed on the Billboard Hot 100 last year.

Frank led Billboard ‘s 2025 year-end Top Christian Artists and Top Christian Artists — Male charts. Additionally, his projects Child of God and Child of God II landed the top two spots on Billboard ‘s 2025 year-end Top Christian Albums chart .
